{{Lang|'''Xian'ge'''|zh=弦歌}} is an NPC in {{Location|Mt. Firmament}}. 
Xian'ge is collecting [[Windchimer]]s to repair the broken Guqin. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Stub Dialogue}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to hand in Windchimer
::'''Xian'ge:''' It's you! Good to meet you again. Did you collect any Windchimers recently? If so, I'd be happy to take them.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Xian'ge:''' Nice to see you again.
::'''Xian'ge:''' Once the Guqin is repaired, I wonder what melodies and stories it may present.
::'''Xian'ge:''' Haha, anticipating the unknown is also one of life's many joys.
:{{DIcon|Exit}}

----
:''After handing in all Windchimers and repairing the Guqin''
:(close the Delivery Completed screen quickly to see this dialogue)
:'''Xian'ge:''' The broken Guqin is finally repaired! Thank you for your help!
:'''Xian'ge:''' Can you feel the stories now? They are all woven into the melody it plays.
:'''Xian'ge:''' I'll transcribe them to text later. Feel free to read them if you like.
:'''Xian'ge:''' I'll stay here, playing the Guqin from now on. If you revisit, you'll always be greeted with my music.
:'''Xian'ge:''' Please take good care of yourself, my friend. Until next time.
----
:''Chat after repairing Guqin''

:{{DIcon}} I'd like to hand in Windchimer
:'''Xian'ge:''' Hello again. Are you here for the music as usual?

:{{DIcon}} Chat
:'''Xian'ge:''' Did you hear it?
:'''Xian'ge:''' People meet each other, say goodbyes, and depart with regrets... All these stories are encapsulated within the music.
:'''Xian'ge:''' Yet, a story is just a story. Be it happy or sad, it has been told, and the end has been set.
:'''Xian'ge:''' What I can do is to unveil and tell these stories concealed within the notes.
:'''Xian'ge:''' After all, a story is meant to be told and to be heard. 
{{Dialogue End}}
